purpose: Immutable provenance and security policy lock for the M-007 repository development environment. This is a provenance/policy lock, not a second environment-description protocol; devcontainer.json remains the single portable environment description.

base_image.project_license: MIT (docker-node project and Node.js runtime; Debian base under its component licenses)
base_image.remediation: Deterministic filesystem-only removal of unused bundled npm and yarn from the immutable official Node 24.19.0 trixie-slim base. No apt/apk install or upgrade, no download, no floating reference, no new tool, and no security-threshold change.
base_image.dockerfile_authority_reason: Owner-integrator authorization after Arena Round-5 stop-report: all tested packet-compliant official Node 24.19.0 Debian variants retained the same 7 bundled-npm HIGH/CRITICAL findings. Packet section 8 requires selecting/remediating the image without weakening thresholds. The owner therefore authorizes only this exact deterministic filesystem-only remediation on the already-selected immutable trixie-slim base; mutable package installation, downloads, new tools and broader Dockerfile use remain outside M-007 authority.

features.purpose: Provides python3 (Debian trixie os-provided) required by all repository-owned stdlib validators/tests. Feature release is immutable by digest.

Provides git (required M-007 environment element; packet 4.2) on the slim official image through the ratified Dev Containers Feature mechanism. version=os-provided installs git from the OS repository (--no-install-recommends) only when git is not already present; ppa=false (ppa only applies to Ubuntu).

permanently_banned: raw secret material in committed/client-readable configuration
silent expansion without an owning later mission declaration

mounts.purpose: Canonical Dev Containers pattern: named volume shadows the host checkout's node_modules inside the container so pnpm install --frozen-lockfile runs non-interactively against a fresh container-local modules dir (fixes ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY) without mutating the host developer's node_modules. Container-local only; no host credential/docker-socket exposure. The volume root is chowned to the host user by initializeCommand so the non-root container user can write it.

initialize_command.purpose: Host-side (initializeCommand) one-shot: chowns the canonical vibeflow-node-modules volume root to the host user so the non-root container user (uid-aligned to the host by devcontainers/ci / VS Code) can write node_modules. Uses the same digest-pinned slim base, runs as root only inside that throwaway chown container, mounts no host paths into the dev container, and never touches the host checkout's node_modules.

durable_extension_policy.rule: After M-007 acceptance, a later owning mission may extend the environment (forwarded ports, additional digest-pinned registered features, benign environment metadata, additional mounts, runArgs, service containers, or a different explicit non-root dev user) only by recording an explicit extension entry here owned by the actually active later mission (mission_id, rationale, exact declared values). The canonical node_modules volume and initializeCommand, the immutable trixie-slim base plus exact deterministic remediation Dockerfile, and the python+git registered features are retained as M-007 baseline. Privileged mode, docker-socket mounts, host networking, Docker-in-Docker, root/absent user fields, and raw secret material remain permanently banned and can never be authorized by a declaration.
